summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Aida Health MVP. Backend: extended pytest suite to 23 tests (added vitals/checkins/tasks/overview) - ALL 23 PASSED against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Gemini 3 Flash integration confirmed for /api/chat, /api/report, /api/overview and /api/labs/upload. Frontend: Expo web preview loads cleanly on 390x844 mobile viewport. Verified Home Puzzle (stat pills, AI-day card, attention card, companion widget, customize sheet toggle, log-data button); Profile switcher (Me/Child/Relative) reloads data; RU/EN language toggle updates UI copy; Health hub navigates to Labs/Pressure/Mind/Medications/Measurements/History; Pressure add measurement works (systolic/diastolic/pulse -> POST /api/vitals kind=bp, list grew 4->5); Mind quick check-in (5 scales) save works (list grew 3->4); Tasks add+toggle+list works (POST/PUT toggle verified); Medications & Measurements pages render; Labs filters (all/normal/high/low) tappable; History filters (all/labs/symptoms/meds) + lab accordion expand works; Aida chat sends message and receives contextual Gemini response referencing seeded BP/labs/symptoms in Russian; Doctor Report modal with 30/90/365 day chips loads. No React Native red screens, no console errors beyond deprecation warnings (see minor).

minor.issue: Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager (server.py:1022, 1033).
Idempotency check uses profiles.count>0 so seed becomes a no-op if profiles were created via POST /api/profiles. Acceptable for MVP but noted.
Does not validate profile_id existence; returns default widgets for any id (inconsistent with 404 elsewhere).
If Gemini fails, orphaned user message remains in DB (persisted before LLM call at server.py:471). Consider rollback or placeholder assistant reply on failure.
Temp file cleanup duplicated in try/except; refactor to try/finally (server.py:299-339).

issues: Console emits React Native Web deprecation warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - RN Web only, non-blocking, but indicates outdated style patterns in components.

action_items: Optional: replace React Native Web deprecated style props (shadow*, pointerEvents) with recommended alternatives (boxShadow / style.pointerEvents) to silence warnings.
Optional: migrate FastAPI startup/shutdown to lifespan API.
Optional: rollback or placeholder assistant message when Gemini call fails in /api/chat to avoid orphan user messages.
Optional: refactor /api/labs/upload to use try/finally for temp file cleanup.
Optional: validate profile existence in GET /api/puzzle/{profile_id} for consistency.

Optional: measurements.tsx button reuses i18n key 'add_pressure' (server.py measurements screen); the RU translation happens to read 'Добавить измерение' but the key name is misleading - consider dedicated 'add_measurement' key.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1036 lines - consider splitting into routers (profiles, labs, chat, vitals, gamification, overview).
clean() helper defined but unused since all queries use projection {'_id': 0} - dead code.
get_profile_context builds JSON context by concatenating 5 collection queries every /chat and /overview call - acceptable for MVP but could be cached.
Frontend api.ts and screens correctly use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and testID coverage is comprehensive (~121 testIDs across screens).
All endpoints correctly use env vars, exclude _id, use async motor, return Pydantic-validated responses, and return proper HTTP status codes.
seed_data_creation: Relied on auto-seed at startup + /api/seed endpoint (3 profiles me/child/relative, meds, symptoms, 1 lab with 5 biomarkers, 4 BP readings, 3 checkins, 3 tasks). UI tests created transient TEST_UI_Task, an extra BP reading (125/82/70), an extra checkin, and chat messages; cleanup left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://life-health-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend fully functional. Frontend Expo web preview loads on mobile viewport (390x844). Pytest: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` (~14s, 23 tests). Deprecated RN Web style warnings emitted in console but non-blocking. Gemini 3 Flash working reliably via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY for chat/overview/report/lab-OCR.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs identified in current iteration.
